## Bread Financial to Participate in the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference


September 8, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.breadfinancial.com/node/30691/pdf)


COLUMBUS, Ohio, Sept. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Bread Financial ® Holdings, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_kYT7YBM74C_sWr0NczLc89d_jDfZpsMlsJPuOuwv7oZbcU7VwWajNeDgAOW7hZuHGVcUFBoEtiHgsucjvz5kQHPpjA4g8o5KQuHe-6YlrNiybQb7fxw9DCT8n-iCq7nWag2TAFnVcjDJ8deUehHRgYm1OA0uA5OzqT_KIOMlY4A9jSjDj_6B5pXD1qagyXZDqGYr-82nWJQWmQrvFZxRRX-VYjM3T9CgO_rjBp129u7Hesg_JySsWZDygHgn-qEgWhHbHZHRF_PBxFI-H5ZUyJW6CW_2UT313rDLzydqKOpCfLU2v8dZKHqJOXjTHMLEJeSChoHaG8eRDj0Ce6lRwkrD_a6s9xc5ek48cWIl2mPCiFlMRXLCaGbz4OBCwwNPdtkZYvfpKaClSc09O4ljU4-waShKShCoQEc_fKI9UyUk0PfTfuNkWgcr9LjoGqQ2ksCXtwTkzAIOl1MSjAvmzAO-otjqSt0rBrqhROz_Aj3R5qTPbajbQ20nKMX5eyc47a3ARA8lcdNP2MS29qDw0FXKA8JWUYwjlFfUAFPSSQb6v67cikzxWVJgg3Uui5b) (NYSE: BFH), a tech-forward financial services company that provides simple, personalized payment, lending, and saving solutions to millions of U.S consumers, today announced the company’s participation in the Barclays 24 **th** Annual Global Financial Services Conference on Tuesday, September 15.


Bread Financial EVP and Chief Financial Officer Perry Beberman will participate in a fireside chat. The fireside chat will take place at 11:15 a.m. ET and will be broadcast live[here.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=hyY-kDaWKRffN67mAgYnFPUA9S0GNZs5mmICGo-qeFuor4DeagtZOw9A5a_QfId8BIFF9QxdvBwQRGCb20XqJNbL-hwcO5SmsAdRPBHOHALL0Wc7d6LjssIC9sWXC0tUPCbuZzA6z69RxKShNl5wyFcv3xlAKPzqkxXhidUtZkI=)


The fireside chat can also be accessed through Bread Financial’s[investor relations website.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iAz-_9yVR9562yEY-oanPX9XTrs7c6Xh9w9swqZIXLx2WzuhbWZ6pXb7GVzTmSEL0otCp1ii_2sOY2NghCuy-oeZUmVSd0v6vRdA0dFs2F3Knzf6CtJf9XosFVpnhm2DApT1vgXEDR0wAUlWUnbndHAJvoGLev_QFwnhWyVkJyw=) A replay of the webcast will be available for 90 days following the event.


**About Bread Financial** **®**
Bread Financial® (NYSE: BFH) is a tech-forward financial services company that provides simple, personalized payment, lending and saving solutions to millions of U.S. consumers. Our payment solutions deliver growth for some of the most recognized brands in travel & entertainment, health & beauty, technology, electronics, jewelry, home and specialty apparel through our co-brand and private label credit cards and pay-over-time products providing choice and value to our shared customers. Additionally, we offer Bread Financial general purpose credit cards and saving products that empower our customers and their passions for a better life.​


Bread Financial proudly marks 30 years of success in 2026.
